🚨 NSE’s latest move on Static IP usage is something every algo trader should pay attention to.

Brokers, traders and algo providers all have responsibilities under the new guidelines.

For traders building their own algos, this is especially important.

Algo trading in India is growing fast, but compliance needs to grow with it.

How do you see this impacting retail algo traders?
This is what it means so calm down a bit may be?
what they will achive with this ? Nothing... only making things harder for retailers. That\'s their main motive since the start.
please elaborate what is the issue?

I don\'t see any direct impact on individual algo traders. The primary objective is to regulate brokers and smaller platforms that sell algo-trading services and allow multiple users to execute algos through their platforms using individual static IP mappings.
